user.title: Temperature Alarm Setup
user.description: Select a temperature sensor to monitor for alarm conditions. If your sensor has no device class, enable the option below to show all sensors.

data.show_all_sensors: My sensor isn't listed (show all sensors)

data_description.show_all_sensors: When enabled, the picker lists every sensor, including sensors without a device class. The chosen sensor must currently report a numeric value.

mode.title: Select Monitoring Mode
mode.description: Choose how to monitor the temperature.

data_description.mode: Min Only: Alert when below minimum. Max Only: Alert when above maximum. Min/Max: Alert when outside range.
data_description.device_class: How Home Assistant announces the alarm: Safety (Unsafe), Problem (Problem), Heat (Hot), Cold (Cold).

thresholds.title: Set Temperature Thresholds
thresholds.description: Define the temperature thresholds for the alarm. Enable the entity option to allow runtime adjustment.

data_description.create_min_entity: When enabled, creates a number entity to adjust the minimum threshold at runtime.
data_description.create_max_entity: When enabled, creates a number entity to adjust the maximum threshold at runtime.

delay.title: Configure Trigger Delay
delay.description: Optionally delay the alarm trigger. The alarm will trigger when EITHER the time elapses OR the update count is reached.

data_description.delay_enabled: When enabled, the alarm will wait before triggering.
data_description.delay_time: Trigger alarm after this many seconds in alarm condition.
data_description.delay_updates: Trigger alarm after this many sensor updates in alarm condition.

error.invalid_entity: Selected entity is not a valid temperature sensor.
error.state_not_numeric: Selected sensor does not currently report a numeric value.
error.min_greater_than_max: Minimum temperature must be less than maximum temperature.

abort.already_configured: This sensor is already configured for temperature alarm monitoring.
